svg.title: How cost_functions times a move
svg.desc: Left: trapezoidal and triangular velocity profiles. Right: three 2.29 m driving edges in a line with the default parameters, timed by stopping at every node (20.3 s), as one run (11.9 s), by SIPP's run-extension rule (11.3 s) and by cruise time only (6.9 s).

g.text: Formulas from cost_functions.cpp (Trapezoid, TimeAtDistance); parameters are the MotionCostParams defaults (locomote 1.0 m/s, 0.2 m/s²); 2.29 m is the most common edge length in the Pecos layout.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Every edge, run and turn is a rest-to-rest trapezoid. Short moves never reach full speed, so the way edges are grouped into runs changes the estimate a lot.
